source.quote: Multi Hot Ways features27 Reel Ways to Pay. Winning combinations can contain only one symbol in an enabled position from each consecutive reel. These combinations are paid from left to right on adjacent reels, beginning with the leftmost reel. Symbols in different positions on the same reel also count as part of the same combination. The Wild symbol substitutes for all other symbols on the27 Ways to Pay, from left to right, if it can create a winning combination. Total winnings from a single spin are multiplied by the Multiplier Reel value to determine the final Total Win.

englishHelp.ways: Multi Hot Ways features 27 Reel Ways Pay. Winning combinations can contain only one symbol in an enabled position from each consecutive reel. These combinations are paid from left to right on adjacent reels, beginning with the leftmost reel. Symbols in different positions on the same reel will also count as part of the same combination. The Wild symbol substitutes for all other symbols on the 27 Ways to Pay, from left to right, if it can create a winning combination. Total winnings from a single spin are multiplied by the Multiplier Reel multiplier to determine the final Total Win.
englishHelp.multiplier: In addition to these standard rules, Multi Hot Ways also includes the X multiplier, which can randomly appear on the left side reel. With five possible multipliers (1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, and 5x), any win can be multiplied for even greater rewards.
